title: add vpc control plane provisioning: interface endpoints, peering, sgs, route53
author: Eleni Kosta
description: Motivation: enable automated provisioning of the VPC-based private control plane resources for Private deployments. This PR adds a reusable Terraform module and Helm hook updates to create multi-AZ private subnets, interface VPC endpoints for SSM and ECR, security group rules for control plane components, cross-account Route53 private hosted zone peering automation, and controlled VPC peering with optional route propagation. The goal is to provide a single, opinionated provisioning flow for on-prem and VPC-based private control plane installs so customers can use the private-installer in air-gapped and VPC-restricted environments without manual network changes. What changed: 1) terraform/modules/vpc-control-plane: new module with inputs for azs/subnet-cidrs, interface endpoint types, allowed prefixes, peering config, and route53 zone ARNs; 2) terraform/examples/private-installer: example usage and variable files for multi-account peering; 3) private-installer/helm: add post-install hooks to validate endpoints and annotate cluster objects for endpoint usage; 4) scripts/networks/upgrade-rollback: upgrade hooks that reconcile peering state during private control plane upgrades and rollback safely on failure; 5) docs/private-deployments/vpc-provisioning.md: operational runbook and troubleshooting; 6) tests/infra: add terratest scenarios (create/destroy) for single-AZ and multi-AZ workflows. Backwards compatibility: module parameters are additive and default to current behavior; the helm hooks are guarded behind a feature flag (enable_vpc_provisioning). Testing: ran terratest suite in sandbox (aws-account-redwood-sbox) for 2 AZs and 3 AZs, validated interface endpoints, Route53 peering, and security group rules. CI: initial terraform fmt/lint failed on generated examples, fixed in follow-up commit. Rollout plan: feature flagged; will be enabled for internal Private deployments and staged to early enterprise customers. Checklist: [x] terraform module implemented [x] examples and vars updated [x] helm hooks added and feature-flagged [x] terratest scenarios added [x] docs and runbook added [x] reviewers approved. Related: aligns with INF-2390 (private control plane automation) and ENG-4821 (installer upgrade safety).
